newsitem.title: USA: ABC/Money consumer comfort index steady Feb 2 wk.
newsitem.headline: ABC/Money consumer comfort index steady Feb 2 wk.

text.p: The Money Magazine/ABC News index of consumer comfort held steady at -3.0 in the week ended February 2.

The survey, this time with 1,032 respondents, polls consumers nationwide about the national economy, their own finances and their willingness to spend money. The poll has a margin of error of plus/minus 3.5 percent.
The survey's measure of confidence in the economy fell to -4.0 from -2.0 the previous week.
Confidence in personal finances climbed to 20 from 18, while Americans' rating of buying climate fell two points to -26.

Confidence fell in all major regions of the nation except the South, where it rose to 0.0 from -3.0, the report said. The Northeast fell to -2.0 from -1.0, the West fell to -8.0 from -4.0 and the Midwest held steady at -2.0.
